title: GET /dashboard router
scope: Single FastAPI router. APIRouter(prefix='/dashboard', tags=['dashboard']). One endpoint: GET / with required Query(...) as_of_date: date and Depends(get_dashboard_service). Returns list[DashboardRow]. Pure delegation — service.list_as_of(as_of_date).

success_criteria.manual: Router can be included by main.py (T-066); GET /api/v1/dashboard?as_of_date=2026-06-30 returns 200 with list payload.
success_criteria.automated: TC-117 (200 OK with rows), TC-130 (response_model serialization), TC-131 (missing as_of_date → 422), TC-132 (malformed date → 422) all pass.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: Pure delegation — endpoint body is one line: `return service.list_as_of(as_of_date)`. response_model=list[DashboardRow] so FastAPI handles serialization. NO try/except for AssertionError from service (let it bubble — invariant breach is a 500 by design).

checkout_prompt: GET /dashboard router created. Pure delegation, response_model=list[DashboardRow]. Ready for mount in T-066.
